verification: CP42 adds a herb-name lookup for the Search page behind the OFF-by-default flag search-herb-names. Names (Vietnamese, Latin, Chinese) come from Wikidata (CC0) via a manual-only GitHub workflow that pushes to the review branch bot/herb-names; names only, no medical claims. The shipped dataset starts empty, so nothing shows until it is refreshed and the flag is raised. Homepage structure is unchanged. CI, Cloudflare deployment and production smoke remain mandatory.
